verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs describe the full loop: send conversation turns to `add`, which extracts individual facts and stores them, then call `search` for semantic, natural-language retrieval, with reranking and user/session scoping so context persists across sessions. Community users report hands-on and production use, and one independently describes it as memory with semantic search. Missing for 10: independent, measured evidence of recall quality across sessions; one hands-on user also notes the structured/unstructured memory interface still needs work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add memories from conversations and retrieve them later with semantic search, so context persists across sessions

citations.quote: You send conversation turns to `add`, then call `search` before the next model request to fetch relevant context.
Mem0 pulls the individual facts out of the conversation and stores each one separately
Retrieve relevant memories from Mem0 using powerful semantic and filtered search capabilities.
Mem0 is a memory layer for LLM agents - persistent, self-improving context that survives across sessions.
That's key-value memory with semantic search.
